prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. This input is an exact orthographic production geometry blockout, NOT a mood image. Materialize it as a realistic hand-crafted ancient southern Xinjiang oasis-town map sprite. Preserve the input camera, framing, every major outer boundary and especially the three lowest footprint corners PIXEL EXACTLY. Do NOT rotate, re-project, tilt, enlarge, narrow, or reposition the blockout. Its ground axes are exactly +0.5 and -0.5 slopes, yaw45 elevation30, required for grid assembly. Add fine weathered ochre adobe, local pale stone foundation, honest timber grain and carved wood screens. Restrained highly detailed realistic historic strategy-game art; no plastic/toy look. Upper-left light, tiny lower-right contact shadow. Keep real transparent RGBA outside silhouette. No text, numbers, guide marks, border, watermark, people, animals, modern objects, landscape, or thick floating display slab. Ground is a flat thin contact surface. All new detail stays WITHIN the guide silhouette. Footprint front-to-side lengths exactly 10:8. Preserve this low wall enclosed court and single rear flat-roof house. Add wooden south gate precisely in existing gap, latticed rear-room doors, small timber grape pergola entirely inside court, tiny jars, low parapets. Keep court mainly empty. Lowest vertices left(208,580), front(830,891), right(1328,642).
